text:
maya: Heads-up: big customer (FinCloud) asked for a 'zero-friction' onboarding path that includes a performance benchmark, a pinned-version SLA option, and a deprecation notice longer than usual. Need input on scope/cost tradeoffs.
jordan: Can you paste their exact ask? pin SLA == reserved capacity + version lock?
maya: They want 99th pctl latency <= 150ms for 1k qps, model pin for 12 months, and a 180-day deprecation notice with data migration assistance.
samir: 150ms @ 1k qps is doable but only on Dedicated with p4d/p6-type machines + quantized model. Cost will be ~3-5x compared to hosted defaults. Also need runbook for fallback.
lisa: Customer is enterprise, willing to pay. They also asked for automated canary rollouts and warm-cache guarantees. Ops-sla?
kira: We can offer warm cache guarantee as a best-effort with a pre-warming window and alerting. Need an on-call playbook for cache-miss storms and circuit-breaker thresholds.
alex: Decision points: 1) Offer pinned SLA as paid add-on? 2) Define benchmark suite to validate pins. 3) Set deprecation window policy variant for paid customers.
maya: Proposed spec draft: include perf benchmark (tail latency, throughput), quality eval (customer prompt set + regression tests), traffic reproduction harness, and a clear cost estimate. If green, allow pin for 12mo with a premium (proposal: +30%).
samir: Quality eval must include the customer's critical prompt set run against the pinned and fallback variants. Also add compatibility shim: automatic fallback to a quantized variant when capacity constrained.
maya: Example perf command they can run to reproduce load locally:
```bash
# run our micro-benchmark runner against their bundle
./benchmark-runner --target https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate --qps 1000 --seq 512 --duration 300 --concurrency 40 --prometheus-endpoint http://metrics.local:9090
```
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: benchmark-runner v3 -> staging at 2025-07-12 09:00 UTC
jordan: :+1: Next steps: I'll draft a customer commercial term with pricing bands and an optional managed-migration add-on. @emma can you review deprecation language?
emma: Need to limit migration assistance to "reasonable efforts" and clarify data retention. I'll propose wording and a short SLA addendum.
maya: OK let's sync Thu 10am. Action items: samir to scope infra cost and fallback latency delta, kira to draft SRE runbook, jordan to draft pricing bands, emma to draft legal language, maya to assemble the spec doc and the benchmark harness.
alex: :eyes: Also consider a one-time migration credit and a tiered deprecation window (180d standard, 270d paid).
maya: Thanks all — I'll drop the initial spec in the handbook and @product-team calendar.
